V3_3_ABSORPTION_BEHAVIOR_DIAGNOSTIC.md.title: V3.3 Absorption: Volume-Price Behavior Classification (69 SV events)
sections: Concept A (current rule): first-half down-vol > second-half; first-half avg down-range > second-half
Concept B (alternative measurement): diminishing selling pressure without monotonic decline; per-bar comparison
Concept C (observed behavior): actual 2026-01->08 dataset patterns
V3_3_ABSORPTION_BEHAVIOR_DIAGNOSTIC.md.key_finding: Dataset shows mixed consolidation (45%) and recovery (33%) rather than declining consolidation. Down-volume declining is genuinely absent, confirming V3.2. This is a dataset/regime characteristic, not an implementation error.
V3_3_ABSORPTION_BEHAVIOR_DIAGNOSTIC.md.recommendation_for_V3_4: If adjusting Absorption, consider an alternative measurement (Concept B) rather than relaxing thresholds; or retain strict definition and accept fewer sequences in this regime.
